title: The Brand Backstory and the Strategic Performance of Transparency
authors: Cristel Antonia Russell, Anne Hamby, Stephanie Feiereisen, Hope Jensen Schau

eligible_reason: Qualitative multimethod study (dramaturgical theory; four backstory sites, organization and consumer interviews). No quantitative panel, no DiD.
design_notes: Interpretive study of four backstory sites (Outrageous Fortune, Herr's, Le Roy Rene, Girl Scouts of the USA). 192 public files: site photographs (jpg/png), video (mpg), press releases and archival PDFs, a theme-coding spreadsheet. The 21 restricted files (not requested) are interview transcripts, field notes, tour materials, French visitor satisfaction questionnaires and the IRB letter.
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract, deposit description ('Qualitative and quantitative data for brand backstory') and file types.
main_text_note: Article confirms an interpretive multimethod study; no quantitative estimation.
